# hivelocity_contact_permissions (Resource)

Sets the full list of permissions granted to a contact. Available permission names come from the `hivelocity_permissions` data source. Destroying the resource revokes all permissions of the contact. The resource ID is the contact ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_permissions" "all" {}

resource "hivelocity_contact_permissions" "oncall" {
  contact_id  = hivelocity_contact.oncall.contact_id
  permissions = ["device.view", "device.power"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_id` (Number) ID of the contact.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission names granted to the contact.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the contact ID
terraform import hivelocity_contact_permissions.oncall 777
```
